full_text: Building a Resilient Business Model with API-Driven Solutions - Skip to content Building a Resilient Business Model with API-Driven Solutions By Aman Singh / 21/03/2025 Many organizations operate in a constant state of reaction, scrambling to fix issues only after they occur. A delayed payment means struggling to pay suppliers. A tax filing error results in last-minute corrections and penalties. An unverified vendor turns out to be unreliable, leading to lost revenue and wasted resources. The problem isn’t just inefficiency but it’s the lack of a proactive, automated, and integrated system that ensures businesses stay agile and prepared for challenges before they arise. Table of Contents Toggle Struggles that threaten business stability Cashflow Cashflow is one of the biggest challenges for businesses, especially MSMEs. Delayed payments from buyers create a ripple effect, disrupting vendor relationships and making it harder to procure raw materials or pay salaries on time. Working capital shortages force businesses to borrow at high costs, eating into profits and creating long-term instability. The traditional approach of manually tracking pending invoices and chasing payments, wastes time and still doesn’t guarantee timely collections. With automated payment workflows, businesses can integrate real-time payment tracking and instant settlement systems into their operations. Payment Reminder APIs automatically notify buyers before the due date, while Payment Link APIs allow businesses to send secure, one-click payment options, ensuring faster settlements. Imagine a manufacturing company grappling with delayed payments. By integrating an Automated Payment Link API, they enabled customers to make quick, one-click payments via UPI, net banking, or credit/debit cards. Within just a few months, the company experienced a 20% drop in overdue payments, resulting in significantly improved cash flow stability. Compliance A single mismatch in invoice data can lead to weeks of manual reconciliation work, delaying payments and tax filings. Invoices may not match with GSTR-2B records, resulting in missed ITC claims and compliance penalties. Manually resolving discrepancies often leads to errors, making businesses vulnerable to audits and penalties. Automated Reconciliation APIs streamline the entire process by matching invoices with government records in real time, flagging mismatches early, and allowing businesses to take corrective action before filing returns. Let’s assume, a mid-sized auto parts supplier struggled with frequent invoice mismatches, delaying their ITC claims. By integrating a GSTR-2B Matching API, they would be able to reduce reconciliation efforts by 80%, ensuring accurate and timely GST filings. Verification and Frauds Onboarding a new vendor or customer is risky without proper verification. Some businesses unknowingly deal with fraudulent vendors or financially unstable clients, leading to unpaid invoices or compliance risks. Manual verification of checking business registrations, PAN numbers, and credit health can take a lot of time and often rely on outdated information. Real-time verification APIs ensure that businesses only work with trusted partners. A Business Verification API can instantly validate company credentials (GST, PAN, MCA), while Credit Risk APIs assess the financial health of that vendor or customer before onboarding. In a scenario where a logistics company frequently faces disputes due to fake vendor registrations, integrating a Business Verification API can ensure every new vendor’s GST and PAN details are being cross-verified against official databases, thereby reducing manual intervention by 70%. This is where Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) make a significant impact. APIs are not just about technology; they can MSMEs automate critical trade processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and scale operations faster. It involves managing the entire tax process, from tracking GSTR filings to reconciling mismatches and avoiding penalties. Businesses often struggle to maintain accurate invoice records, track Input Tax Credit (ITC) eligibility, and meet government deadlines. GSTR Tracking APIs help businesses automatically fetch and reconcile invoices with GSTR-2B, eliminating mismatches and ensuring proper ITC claims. Supplier, buyer, and workforce verification In B2B trade, verifying suppliers and buyers before entering into agreements is crucial to prevent fraud, defaults, and financial losses. Many MSMEs lack access to real-time verification tools, making them vulnerable to engaging with unreliable partners. Checking a vendor’s GST status, validating MCA records, or assessing a buyer’s financial stability manually is time-consuming and prone to human errors. Payment delays and automation gaps Delayed payments remain one of the biggest concerns for MSMEs, disrupting cash flow and daily operations. Many businesses struggle to track outstanding invoices, send timely reminders, and enforce payment terms effectively. Despite the MSMED Act, 2006, which mandates payment within 45 days, enforcement remains weak; only 20% of complaints have been resolved, according to government data (Financial Express). This is where payment automation APIs play a transformative role. They help MSMEs automate reminders, trigger follow-ups, and send payment links. full_text: How Cash Flow Automation Can Streamline Your Business - Skip to content How Cash Flow Automation Can Streamline Your Business By Aman Singh / 30/08/2024 In today’s rapidly evolving business landscape, maintaining a steady cash flow is crucial for growth. However, manual cash flow management processes are often plagued by inefficiencies and errors that can stifle a business’s ability to thrive. This article explores how cash flow automation management can significantly enhance your business operations and ensure long-term financial stability. Table of Contents Toggle The Pain of Traditional Cash Flow Management Traditional cash flow management typically involves manually tracking and reconciliation of all incoming and outgoing funds. This process can lead to several challenges: Payment Delays – Manual processes often result in staff being slow to process invoices and payments, leading to cashflow delays. Payment follow-ups with customers tend to be irregular, inconsistent, and reactive rather than proactive. These follow-ups are often marred by delays in information sharing and further complicated by inaccurate information, causing payment delays that can range from several days to even weeks. Increased Costs: Manual management requires more time and labour, driving up operational costs. Additionally, delayed collections can lead to significant opportunity loss, as businesses miss out on better investment opportunities or face reduced returns on capital. The financial impact is further compounded by higher interest payments on borrowed funds needed to cover cash shortfalls caused by these delays. Inaccurate Forecasting: Predicting future cash needs can be difficult without real-time data, leading to potential shortfalls. Supply Chain Disruptions: Inefficient cash flow management can strain supplier relationships, causing delays in the supply chain and impacting overall business operations. Payment delays and reconciliation errors were common, tying up valuable resources and creating financial bottlenecks that impacted their day-to-day operations. To address these issues, FF21 turned to our Cash flow Automation APIs . The integration was seamless, and the results were immediate. Automated invoicing and payment reminders ensured that collections were timely, while the real-time data provided by the APIs enabled accurate cash flow forecasting. The reconciliation process, once a major pain point, became efficient and error-free, freeing up the team to focus on more strategic initiatives. title: SAP Plugin
full_text: SAP Plugin Skip to content Automate KYC/KYB APIs within SAP Atlas SAP Plugin enables instant KYC/KYB API access inside SAP via CPI - perfect for integrating PAN, MSME status, bank checks, GSTIN, and many more within your ERP. Get in Touch Verify & Enrich Master Data directly Inside ERP Bulk Verification Batch Verification Instantly Real-Time APIs Real-Time Verification from source Plug-and-Play plug-in Pre-built for SAP S/4 HANA Robust Support Expert support, easy implementation APIs active to fuel your workflows Active APIs Under Testing PAN verification GSTIN Verification MSME Status check Bank Account Verification View & Track GST Returns MCA Instant TAN Verification Driving licence Vehicle RC Verification Quick Glimpse: SAP Plug‑in in Action FAQs What is Atlas iFlow? Atlas plug-in is Vayana’s SAP-ready integration , enabling enterprises to use KYC/KYB APIs (PAN, GSTIN, Bank Account, MSME, Vehicle, etc.) directly within SAP S/4HANA. Why do KYC/KYB need Verification APIs in SAP? They help validate supplier, vendor, customer, or employee data at the source, reducing fraud, duplicate records, and compliance errors. Which KYC/KYB APIs are available with Atlas iFlow? PAN Verification GSTIN Verification Bank Account Verification MSME (Udyam) Status Check Vehicle Registration Validation (with more APIs being added regularly) Do we need changes in our SAP system? No major changes are required . Atlas plug-in is designed as a plug-and-play integration with minimal configuration. Can bulk KYC/KYB be done? Yes, the APIs are scalable and can process high volumes, suitable for enterprises with large vendor or customer databases. How secure is Atlas iFlow? All API calls are encrypted and routed through secure government-authori s ed sources. CPI only passes data – it does not store sensitive information. What is the pricing model? Pricing is based on API usage/volume. How do we get started? Request a demo from Vayana’s SAP team. Setup is quick, and enterprises can begin verifying records inside SAP almost immediately .
